notablePrerequisites:
Thraben Doomsayer does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Thraben Doomsayer.
description:
Activate Thraben Doomsayer by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Human creature token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Human.
When the Human dies, Thraben Doomsayer triggers, untapping Thraben Doomsayer.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.
